title: Bajo et al.'s leading-coefficient conjecture for trees
statement: Let $G$ be a graph, and let $\widetilde{\chi}_G^\mathbbm{1}(q,x)$ denote the polynomial introduced in the source for the linear form $\mathbbm{1}=(1,1,\ldots,1)$. **Bajo et al.'s conjecture.** The leading coefficient of $\widetilde{\chi}_G^\mathbbm{1}(q,x)$ distinguishes trees. The source attributes this conjecture to Bajo et al.; its resolution is not specified here.
source_name: Matthias Beck, Benjamin Braun and Alvaro Cornejo, “Generating functions of q-chromatic polynomials”, arXiv:2509.22946 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22946

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2025).
